title: Left inverse A of an injective linear map L with ‖L∘A‖ ≤ 1
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ and let L : ℝ^d → ℝ^P be an injective continuous linear map. Then there is a continuous linear map A : ℝ^P → ℝ^d such that A∘L = id_{ℝ^d} and the operator norm of L∘A : ℝ^P → ℝ^P satisfies ‖L∘A‖ ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (L : Euclid d →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Injective L → ∃ A : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid d, A.comp L = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid d) ∧ ‖L.comp A‖ ≤ 1
